draft.text: You came in because you've been feeling anxious and stressed, especially during the holidays.
You also wanted to talk about your blood sugar levels and how to manage them without medication.
Your HbA1c result is a bit high, which means your blood sugar levels have been higher than they should be.
You're taking metformin and lisinopril as prescribed, and your blood pressure has been moderate.
Your high HbA1c could be due to inconsistent eating habits, less physical activity, and stress.
You're not ready for medication and are looking into talk therapy as an alternative.
You'll continue to monitor your blood sugar levels and make lifestyle changes to improve control.
You'll follow up with your doctor in a few months to check your progress and adjust your plan if needed.
